Title: Relief Stores Request
BodyText: The storehouse steward asks whether to release reserve money and materials for the first relief wagons.
OptionA_ResultText: The first wagons leave with sealed storehouse orders.
OptionB_ResultText: The request is returned for later review.
OptionA_ProposerFeedbackText: The steward bows and sends runners to the lower district.
OptionB_ProposerFeedbackText: The steward keeps the seal but loses time.
OptionA_FactionFeedbackText: Relief workers trust the council a little more.
OptionB_FactionFeedbackText: Residents hear that the stores remain closed.

Title: Route Papers
BodyText: The courier brings a route plan through flooded streets and asks for approval before the convoy moves.
OptionA_ResultText: The convoy follows the prepared route.
OptionB_ResultText: The convoy waits for scouts and loses food stores.
OptionA_ProposerFeedbackText: The courier accepts the route mark.
OptionB_ProposerFeedbackText: The courier leaves in a hurry.
OptionA_FactionFeedbackText: The lower district sees carts arrive before nightfall.
OptionB_FactionFeedbackText: The academy notes a cautious but costly survey.

Title: Guard Detail
BodyText: The steward asks whether guards should escort the relief carts through the market road.
OptionA_ResultText: The carts move under guard without incident.
OptionB_ResultText: The carts move alone and several sacks are lost.
OptionA_ProposerFeedbackText: The steward records the escort order.
OptionB_ProposerFeedbackText: The steward worries about the exposed convoy.
OptionA_FactionFeedbackText: Noble patrols approve the visible order.
OptionB_FactionFeedbackText: Residents blame the hall for leaving carts unprotected.

Title: Follow-up Receipt
BodyText: A delayed receipt arrives from the first reserve release.
OptionA_ResultText: The receipt is filed and the food count is corrected.
OptionA_ProposerFeedbackText: The courier adds the paper to the archive.
OptionB_ProposerFeedbackText: The courier leaves the receipt on the desk.
OptionA_FactionFeedbackText: Residents see cleaner accounting for relief food.
OptionB_FactionFeedbackText: Residents suspect the records are being ignored.
